item.title: March tips for your Peninsula garden: Soil prep, frost damage and growing carrots in heavy clay
item.description: Now is a good time to plant carrots. Carrots thrive in cool weather and can be planted before the final frost of spring. Early planting leads to sweeter, crisper harvests. If you have a light, fluffy soil, perhaps in a raised bed, you can grow those long beautiful carrots you see in the grocery store. item.title: Palo Alto may back sanctuary cities facing federal suits
item.description: Palo Alto will consider joining a growing list of cities that support jurisdictions being sued by the United States Department of Justice for their sanctuary city policies, which limit local law enforcement from assisting federal immigration operations. item.title: Palo Alto may end rideshare program amid bleak budget outlook
item.description: It’s been a year of change and uncertainly for Palo Alto Link, the rideshare service that the city launched in March 2023 and that continues to fight for its life in the face of an increasingly skeptical City Council. The pattern held on Monday, as council members wrestled with various unpopular option, including discontinuation.
